endorsements.name: Andy Tan
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-6502
endorsements.description: A potential Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Security vulnerability has been identified in ArcSight Management Center (ArcMC) in all versions prior to 2.81. This vulnerability could be exploited to allow for Reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.0, 6.5)
